description: Writes the campaign's real date, time and timezone into the thank-you page where a fixed text still shows an old one, which is the repair for a participant who registers and then reads the wrong day. Side effect: it writes on the connected WordPress site. Only the date text on that page changes; no other wording and no campaign field. Needs `session_id` and `webinar_id` from wi_list_webinars. wi_run_webinar_preflight reports whether such a deviation exists; this tool is the fix for it. For any other line on that page use wi_change_webinar_text.

confirm.description: Only after the site answered code admin_editing: the host agreed to overwrite unsaved changes in wp-admin.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_fix_thankyou_date
title: Fix a wrong date on the thank-you page
